headlines.headline: Duke tops preseason Power 44 as Arizona, fresh off Final Four run, looms as challenger
headlines.detail: Duke opened at No. 1 in Andy Katz's first Power 44 rankings for 2026-27. Arizona, coming off a 36-win season and its first Final Four since 2001, carries championship expectations into a Midnight Madness event at McKale Center on Sept. 26.

headlines.headline: Pistons lock up Ausar Thompson on 5-year, $155M extension, turning up heat on Jalen Duren stalemate
headlines.detail: Detroit and Thompson agreed to a fully guaranteed five-year, $155M rookie-scale extension a day after his All-Defensive First Team season, intensifying pressure to resolve the Jalen Duren contract standoff before his Oct. 1 qualifying-offer deadline.

headlines.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray ruled out vs. Bears with concussion, Carson Wentz to start
headlines.detail: Murray will miss Sunday's divisional matchup after suffering a concussion in Week 1, handing the start to veteran Carson Wentz as Minnesota opens Week 2 shorthanded at quarterback.

headlines.headline: Vanderbilt stuns NC State 35-31 on fumble-return TD with one second left
headlines.detail: Trailing by 17 at one point, Vanderbilt completed the comeback when Wolfpack QB CJ Bailey fumbled trying to run out the clock from his own 5-yard line, and Cayden Daniels returned it for the game-winning score as time expired.
